messages:
Samira Khan: Deployed the SDK sample to Cloudflare Workers and hit `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined`. Also saw `setInterval` not firing for token refresh. anyone with quick fixes?
Ben Holt: Buffer + process leaks are from Node-targeted bundles. For Workers we need an edge build with platform="browser". Swap Buffer uses to Uint8Array + atob/btoa.
Ivy Park: For auth: ditch background setInterval. Workers won't keep timers between invocations. Use on-demand refresh: check expiry at request and call refresh if needed.
Sophia Chen: Suggestion: add a tiny runtime shim file `edge-helpers.ts` in samples exporting: `isEdge()`, `decodeBase64`, `encodeBase64`, and `ensureToken()` (on-demand refresh). Keep it zero-dep.
Ben Holt: Also publish dual bundles: `dist/edge.mjs` (ESM/browser) and `dist/node.cjs`. Use package.json exports to guide imports. That prevents accidental polyfills.
Samira Khan: Good. We'll update sample to import `./edge-helpers` and switch to the edge entrypoint. I'll also add a tsconfig note to include DOM lib.
Devex-Bot: Internal note created: https://redwood-internal.example.com/devex/edge/compat-checklist Includes edge build flags, auth on-demand pattern, and sample shim. :white_check_mark:
Samira Khan: Thanks — opening PR with changes and linking here when done. :thumbsup:
